rules: RULE — Deploy only capabilities that require shared/continuous availability; keep doctrine, contracts, CLIs, and private operator state local/on-demand.
RULE — One component owns each runtime responsibility; Foundation, Playbook, Atlas Book, and _stack must not duplicate authority.
patterns: PATTERN — Hosted edge for public callbacks/state, supervised loopback services for private operator tooling, event-triggered recomputation for read models.
failure_modes: FAILURE MODE — Serverizing the Control Plane: deploying local/private doctrine or operator machinery merely because a server command exists.
FAILURE MODE — Duplicate Cockpit: Foundation and Playbook both becoming competing operational dashboards.
FAILURE MODE — Poller Proliferation: multiple permanent watchers replacing one serialized lease/idempotency-controlled sweep.
authority_invariants: No new general-purpose ATLAS server is admitted.
Foundation is the hosted read-only portfolio surface; Playbook Observer is the private local operator cockpit.
DiscordOS is the hosted Discord API and logical writer; its Vercel, Supabase, and GitHub Actions surfaces retain distinct responsibilities.
Cortex recomputes read models after accepted state changes or digests and does not become a competing daemon or scheduler.
Fitness, Mazer, Socials OS, FawxzzyWeb, Stream, Nat1, and other products remain owner lanes.
governance.production_deploy_guard: Every production deployment, promotion, or production-alias cutover requires explicit current-thread, per-project, per-deploy approval. This packet authorizes none.
